stories.title: Google buys Spirit Airlines data for AI training for just $10 million — purchase includes hundreds of millions of emails, Microsoft Teams chats, billions of flight pricing records, and anonymized passenger records

sources.summary: A U.S. bankruptcy court auctioned off Spirit Airlines' treasure trove of data, with Google making the winning bid. stories.title: Judge allegedly outsourced entire ruling to AI and still can't be sued — federal court upholds blanket judicial immunity

sources.title: Judge allegedly outsourced entire ruling to AI and still can't be sued — federal court upholds blanket judicial immunity
sources.title_en: Judge allegedly outsourced entire ruling to AI and still can't be sued — federal court upholds blanket judicial immunity
sources.title_original: Judge allegedly outsourced entire ruling to AI and still can't be sued — federal court upholds blanket judicial immunity
sources.summary: A U.S. federal court has ruled that a judge accused of relying entirely on AI to make a judicial decision can still retain judicial immunity from civil lawsuits, although the ruling does not determine whether such use of AI is legally or ethically permissible.
sources.summary_zh: 美国联邦法院裁定，被指控完全依赖人工智能做出司法决定的法官仍然可以保留民事诉讼的司法豁免权，尽管该裁决并未确定这种人工智能的使用在法律或道德上是否允许。

stories.title: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node

sources.title: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
sources.title_en: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
sources.title_original: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
sources.summary: Nova Lake desktop CPUs look to be the exclusive recipient of bLLC, Intel's answer to AMD's X3D, as the company looks to debut bLLC on mobile with Razor Lake-HX, and possibly Razor Lake-AX. As such, the Razor Lake family is also rumored to be manufactured on TSCM's N2X process node.
sources.summary_zh: Nova Lake 桌面 CPU 有望成为 bLLC 的独家接收者，bLLC 是英特尔对 AMD X3D 的回应，因为该公司希望通过 Razor Lake-HX 以及可能的 Razor Lake-AX 在移动设备上首次推出 bLLC。因此，据传 Razor Lake 系列也将在 TSCM 的 N2X 工艺节点上制造。
